description: End-to-end SD-WAN service design, ordering, deployment, and lifecycle management for B2B telco customers.

customer_id.description: Unique identifier of the B2B customer (enterprise account).

site_id.description: Unique identifier of a customer site/location.

topology_id.description: Identifier of an SD-WAN topology design (e.g., hub-spoke, mesh).

design_id.description: Identifier of a complete SD-WAN service design for a customer.

quote_id.description: Identifier of a commercial quote for an SD-WAN design.

order_id.description: Identifier of an SD-WAN service order.

deployment_id.description: Identifier of a deployment workflow instance.

policy_id.description: Identifier of an SD-WAN policy object (e.g., application, QoS, security).

ticket_id.description: Identifier of a support / change / incident ticket related to the SD-WAN service.

device_profile.description: Template describing CPE/edge device characteristics and capabilities.

features.description: Enabled feature set for this profile.

wan_link.description: Definition of a WAN underlay link for a site.

policy_object.description: Generic policy object used in SD-WAN policies.

match.description: Match criteria depending on policy type.

actions.description: Policy actions depending on policy type.

functions.name: design_sd_wan_topology
functions.description: Create or update an SD-WAN topology and site design for a customer.

regions.description: Regions involved in the SD-WAN deployment.

sites.description: List of sites to be included in the topology.

items.description: LAN subnets at the site in CIDR notation.

existing_topology_id.description: If provided, the existing topology will be updated.

functions.returns: New or updated topology_id along with a normalized topology summary.

functions.name: create_sd_wan_design
functions.description: Generate a full SD-WAN service design including policies and templates based on a topology.

site_overrides.description: Site-specific overrides to the default policy sets.

version_label.description: Optional human-readable version name for this design.

functions.returns: A design_id representing the generated SD-WAN design and a summary of key policies and templates.

functions.name: get_sd_wan_design
functions.description: Retrieve full details of an SD-WAN design including topology, sites, and policies.

include.description: Optional sections to include in the response.

functions.returns: Complete SD-WAN design object with requested sections.

functions.name: estimate_sd_wan_cost
functions.description: Generate a commercial estimate/quote for a given SD-WAN design.

target_id.description: ID of site/region when scope is not global.

include_breakdown.description: Whether to return a line-item breakdown by site, link, and license.

functions.returns: A quote_id and estimated recurring/non-recurring charges with optional breakdown.

functions.name: create_sd_wan_order
functions.description: Create an SD-WAN service order from an approved design and quote.

site_activation_preferences.description: Per-site preferences such as desired RFS dates and maintenance windows.

terms_accepted.description: Indicates that commercial and technical terms have been accepted.

functions.returns: An order_id, initial order status, and a summary of ordered services per site.

functions.name: get_sd_wan_order_status
functions.description: Retrieve full status and milestones of an SD-WAN service order.

site_id.description: If provided, filter status for a specific site.

functions.returns: Order status, per-site provisioning status, and requested additional sections.

functions.name: schedule_sd_wan_deployment
functions.description: Create and schedule a deployment workflow for a confirmed SD-WAN order.

sites.description: Required when deployment_scope is selected_sites or pilot_only.

staged_activation.description: If true, configuration is pushed but traffic cutover is manual.

functions.returns: A deployment_id and an initial deployment plan including tasks and schedule.

functions.name: get_deployment_status
functions.description: Get real-time status of an SD-WAN deployment workflow.

site_id.description: Optional filter for a specific site within the deployment.

functions.returns: Deployment status including failed/pending tasks and optional logs.

functions.name: retry_deployment_step
functions.description: Retry failed deployment steps for specific sites or tasks, with optional rollback.

rollback_before_retry.description: If true, attempt rollback to last known good config before retry.

max_rollback_steps.description: Maximum number of configuration versions to roll back.

reason.description: Operator-provided reason for the retry operation.

functions.returns: Updated deployment status after scheduling retries and/or rollbacks.

functions.name: publish_sd_wan_policies
functions.description: Publish or update SD-WAN policies to the production controller for selected sites.

sites.description: Sites for which policies will be published. If omitted, apply globally.

policy_ids.description: If omitted, all policies from design for that site are published.

functions.returns: Policy publication job identifier, affected sites, and expected impact window.

functions.name: modify_sd_wan_service
functions.description: Modify an existing SD-WAN service (e.g., add a site, change bandwidth, update policies).

design_id.description: Current active design to be used as a baseline.

simulate_only.description: If true, only impact analysis is performed without applying changes.

functions.returns: New design_id for the modified service, impact analysis, and if simulate_only=false, a change implementation plan.

functions.name: cancel_sd_wan_order
functions.description: Cancel an SD-WAN order fully or partially before or during deployment.
functions.returns: Cancellation confirmation, including impacted sites, fees, and billing adjustments.

functions.name: open_sd_wan_support_ticket
functions.description: Open a support or incident ticket related to an SD-WAN service, with context linking to design/order/deployment.

attachments.description: Optional list of references to logs, screenshots, or packet captures.

functions.returns: ticket_id and initial ticket status, with SLA targets and assigned support group.

functions.name: search_sd_wan_orders
functions.description: Faceted search across SD-WAN service orders with rich filters, time windows, pagination, and aggregations.

facets.description: Facets to compute alongside the result set.

projection.description: Fields to include in the result objects.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A page of SD-WAN service order summaries with facet aggregations, pagination cursor, and optional scoring metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_sd_wan_orders
functions.description: Create multiple SD-WAN service orders in a single atomic or best-effort batch with idempotency and partial-commit options.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A bulk-job descriptor with per-item outcomes, created SD-WAN service order ids, error reasons for failures, and an aggregate counts summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_sd_wan_orders
functions.description: Apply patch-style updates to many SD-WAN service orders with optimistic concurrency and partial-failure handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-item update outcomes (success/failure with reason), new versions for each SD-WAN service order, and a summary of skipped and quarantined items.

functions.name: bulk_archive_sd_wan_orders
functions.description: Archive or soft-delete many SD-WAN service orders in one call with retention, audit reason, and webhook notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id outcome, new lifecycle state for each SD-WAN service order, scheduled purge date if applicable, and a job id for tracking.

functions.name: export_sd_wan_orders
functions.description: Export SD-WAN service order datasets to an external sink in CSV, JSON, Parquet, or NDJSON with filters and signed-URL delivery.

split_by.description: Field to shard output by, e.g., tenant_id.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with job id, estimated row count, signed-URL(s) when applicable, and asynchronous completion event details.

functions.name: import_sd_wan_orders
functions.description: Bulk-import SD-WAN service order records from a file or staging table with schema mapping, validation, and quarantine handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An import job descriptor with counts of valid, invalid, and quarantined rows, sample error messages, and identifiers of created or updated SD-WAN service orders.

functions.name: subscribe_to_sd_wan_order_events
functions.description: Register a webhook or message-bus subscription to receive SD-WAN service order lifecycle events with filtering and retry policy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created subscription record with id, secret rotation hint, active state, and an example test-event payload for the SD-WAN service order.

functions.name: get_sd_wan_order_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the immutable audit trail for a SD-WAN service order, including who changed what, when, and from which channel.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A chronologically ordered list of audit entries for the SD-WAN service order, each with actor, action, before/after diff, source, and optional evidence links.

functions.name: schedule_recurring_sd_wan_order_job
functions.description: Create or update a recurring job for SD-WAN service orders using cron, ISO interval, or calendar windows with backfill and concurrency controls.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated schedule descriptor with id, next run time, effective cron, and any backfill plan summary for the SD-WAN service order action.

functions.name: simulate_sd_wan_order_changes
functions.description: Preview the effect of a proposed change to a SD-WAN service order without persisting, returning a diff and impact analysis.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A simulation report showing the resulting state of the SD-WAN service order, a structured diff, policy-check verdicts, and a quantitative impact estimate (cost, latency, blast radius).

functions.name: request_sd_wan_order_approval
functions.description: Create an approval workflow request for a SD-WAN service order change, with multi-stage approvers, SLA, and evidence attachments.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An approval-request descriptor with id, current stage, list of pending approvers, SLA deadlines, and links to the SD-WAN service order under change.

functions.name: decide_sd_wan_order_approval
functions.description: Record an approver decision (approve, reject, request changes) on a pending SD-WAN service order approval request.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

expected_stage.description: Optimistic concurrency check on the approval stage.

functions.returns: The updated approval-request state including new stage, list of completed and pending approvers, and any condition list applied to the SD-WAN service order.

functions.name: add_sd_wan_order_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment, mention, or note to a SD-WAN service order for collaboration and case-management context.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted comment record with id, threading info, visibility, mention/notification fan-out summary for the SD-WAN service order.

functions.name: upload_sd_wan_order_attachment
functions.description: Upload or link a binary attachment (evidence, log bundle, screenshot, contract) to a SD-WAN service order with scanning and retention.

inline_data.description: Base64 payload when kind is inline_base64.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created attachment record with id, scan verdicts, signed download URL, checksum, and link to the SD-WAN service order.

functions.name: create_sd_wan_order_snapshot
functions.description: Capture an immutable point-in-time snapshot of a SD-WAN service order (state, configuration, dependencies) for audit or rollback.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A snapshot record with id, size, checksum, encryption metadata, and a reference to the SD-WAN service order version captured.

functions.name: restore_sd_wan_order_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a SD-WAN service order from a snapshot with selectable scope, validation pre-checks, and notification on completion.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A restore-operation descriptor with operation id, pre-restore snapshot id, validation results, conflict resolutions applied, and final state of the SD-WAN service order.

functions.name: get_sd_wan_order_metrics
functions.description: Compute and return KPI/metrics aggregates for SD-WAN service orders over a time window with grouping, filters, and percentiles.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A metrics result with aggregate values, percentiles, optional period-over-period deltas, sparkline series per group, and the SD-WAN service order domain context.

functions.name: get_sd_wan_order_dashboard
functions.description: Return a pre-composed dashboard view for SD-WAN service orders combining KPIs, alerts, top offenders, and time series.

personalize_for.description: User id to personalize widgets for.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A dashboard payload with KPI tiles, time-series data, top offenders, active alerts, and personalization metadata for the SD-WAN service order context.

functions.name: create_sd_wan_order_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule applied to SD-WAN service orders with versioning, scope, and rollout strategy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated policy record with id, version, rollout plan, scope, and an effective-evaluation summary against current SD-WAN service orders.

functions.name: evaluate_sd_wan_order_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a SD-WAN service order in dry-run, returning per-rule verdicts and proposed actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-policy and per-rule verdicts with reasons, trace data, and a list of proposed (or applied, when apply_actions=true) actions against the SD-WAN service order.

functions.name: get_sd_wan_order_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the upstream and downstream dependency graph for a SD-WAN service order including services, devices, tickets, and contracts.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A graph payload (nodes, edges, optional health and metrics) describing dependencies for the SD-WAN service order, with depth and direction respected.

functions.name: link_sd_wan_order_to_related
functions.description: Create or remove an association between a SD-WAN service order and another business object (incident, ticket, contract, asset).

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The resulting association record (or removal confirmation) including direction, relation type, and a snapshot of the related-object summary for the SD-WAN service order.

functions.name: assign_sd_wan_order_owner
functions.description: Assign or reassign ownership/roles on a SD-WAN service order with hand-off rules, watchers, and notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The updated assignment roster for the SD-WAN service order with effective windows, hand-off receipts, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: tag_sd_wan_orders
functions.description: Apply, remove, or replace tags and labels on one or more SD-WAN service orders, with conflict resolution and audit.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id tag-application outcomes with final tag sets and counts of added/removed/skipped operations for each SD-WAN service order.

functions.name: compare_sd_wan_order_versions
functions.description: Produce a structured diff between two versions (or snapshots) of a SD-WAN service order with semantic equivalence handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A diff document describing added, removed, and changed fields between the two versions of the SD-WAN service order, with optional side-by-side rendering.

functions.name: configure_sd_wan_order_retry_policy
functions.description: Configure default retry, backoff, and circuit-breaker policy applied to SD-WAN service order operations and their downstream actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted retry/circuit-breaker policy with id, effective scope, and a summary of SD-WAN service order operations that match the new policy.

functions.name: check_sd_wan_order_health
functions.description: Run a synthetic health/probe sweep against a SD-WAN service order and its critical dependencies and return aggregated health status.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Aggregated health verdict for the SD-WAN service order, per-probe results, dependency roll-up, and any alert notifications dispatched.

functions.name: clone_sd_wan_order
functions.description: Clone a SD-WAN service order into a new instance with selective fields, optional rename, and link-back metadata.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The cloned SD-WAN service order record with id, lineage link to the source, and a summary of fields reset, copied, or skipped.

functions.name: generate_sd_wan_order_report
functions.description: Generate a formatted SD-WAN service order report (executive, operational, compliance) and deliver via email/object storage.

schedule_id.description: When generated by a recurring schedule.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A report-generation receipt with report id, download URL or delivery confirmation, page/sheet count, and the SD-WAN service order window covered.

functions.name: escalate_sd_wan_order
functions.description: Escalate a SD-WAN service order to a higher tier or owner group with reason, severity bump, and watcher fan-out.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The escalation record with new owner/tier, severity, SLA, watchers, and a log of notifications sent for the SD-WAN service order.
